theme.label: UI Theme
theme.hint: When following the IDE, the theme switches with the IDE light/dark theme automatically

font.label: Font Size
font.hint: Scales the entire UI (icons and spacing included); applies to all session tabs

language.label: Language
language.hint: Switch the UI language; applies to all session tabs

chatBg.label: Chat Background
chatBg.hint: Customize the background color of the chat area and input box

chatBar.label: Top Bar Color
chatBar.hint: Customize the top title bar color; text and border colors adapt by contrast automatically

userMsg.label: User Bubble Color
userMsg.hint: Customize the user message bubble background; text color adapts by contrast automatically

other.title: Other Settings
other.desc: Input history completion and history management
other.completionHint: Matches history by prefix while typing; press Tab to accept the gray suggestion. The ↑↓ history navigation in the input box is unaffected when off
other.clearLowTooltip: Delete all records that were used only once
other.importanceHint: Importance = usage count; the higher, the more often used; increases by 1 automatically on each send
other.confirmClearAllMsg: This will delete all {{count}} history records. This cannot be undone.
other.confirmClearLowMsg: This will delete {{count}} records that were used only once. This cannot be undone.
